title: CreativesFile
description:
`snap/<date>/creatives.json` - per-ad creative identity + asset refs.
Envelope object (new artifacts always get one); the snapshot loader
rule is: bare array => v0 rows, object => read `schema` + `rows`.

fetched_at.description: When the fetch ran (RFC3339, UTC). Provenance, not a join key.

schema.description:
Artifact identity, `moneyball.creatives/<major>`. Readers reject
majors they don't know; unknown FIELDS are ignored everywhere.

AssetRef.description:
A cached creative image, content-addressed under
`history/assets/creatives/<hh>/<sha256>.<ext>`.

sha256.description: Content hash of the cached bytes = cache filename stem.

CreativeRow.description:
One ad's creative facts. Facts only - the creative GROUPING key is
computed at report time (families/name-normalization are editorial
policy, not snapshot facts).

_product.description: Workspace product tag - same rule as ads_daily rows.

ad_id.description: Meta ad id. Primary key within a snapshot.

afs_video_ids.description: Dynamic (asset_feed_spec) video ids, sorted. Empty if none.

asset.description: None if the download failed (report renders a placeholder).

created_time.description: Creative created time as Meta returns it (RFC3339 with offset).

image_basename.description:
CDN asset filename from image_url, query stripped. Legacy
identity fallback only (python creative_key()).

image_hash.description: Meta's content hash for image ads; None for video.

image_url.description:
Full-res URL AT FETCH TIME. Signatures expire within days; the
read path never dereferences this - the asset cache is truth.

permalink.description: IG/FB permalink when Meta exposes one.

video_id.description: Top-level or video_data video id; None for image ads.
